title: Absolute Value Is Even
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Classify f(x)=|x| as even, odd, or neither, using the definition of absolute value.

steps.title: Negate the Input
steps.explanation: Substituting -x produces the absolute value of the negated number.

steps.title: Use Distance Interpretation
steps.explanation: A number and its opposite sit the same distance from 0, so their absolute values coincide.
steps.why: Definition of absolute value as distance: |-a| = |a| for all real a.

steps.title: Conclude
steps.explanation: The even identity holds everywhere; the V-shaped graph mirrors across the y-axis.
steps.why: Global validity of f(-x)=f(x) means even.
